steps.title: Calculate percentage
steps.body:

\[
\text{normal price of A}=140\times \frac{6}{5}=168
\]

steps.title: Calculate percentage
steps.body:

\[

\]

steps.title: The difference is
steps.body:
The difference is

\[
170-168=2
\]

\]
